items.raw_excerpt: A member of the executive on Oldebroek council in Gelderland has apologised for posting a photograph of himself posing with a Kalashnikov in front of a pro-Russian flag. Standing next to him in the photo is a former Almere council candidate for the far-right FvD party, according to the Volkskrant. Tom de Nooijer, of the local Christelijk Verbond Oldebroek party, shared the image on Instagram after visiting Transnistria, a self-declared, unrecognised pro-Russian region that broke away from Moldov
items.summary_en: A council member in Oldebroek, Gelderland apologised for posting a photo of himself with a Kalashnikov in front of a pro-Russian flag. He shared the image on Instagram after visiting Transnistria, a breakaway region from Moldova. The photo caused controversy in local politics.
